title: Disentangle Grasshopper From Engine
description: Refactor Semio.Grasshopper to be a thin UI layer. Move CRUD operations to Semio.cs with direct SQLite kit manipulation using diff-based operations matching semio.ts patterns. Remove engine HTTP dependency from Grasshopper. Implement KitSqlite class in Semio.cs for local static SQLite kit operations.
summary: Fixed remaining KitSqlite issues: Type.IsAbstract null default false for NOT NULL column, Piece.IsHidden/IsLocked null default false, Design.IsAbstract/CanScale/CanMirror nullable DBNull handling, disabled FK enforcement during SaveKit due to schema FK mismatch on attribute.connector_guid. All 11 tests pass including new Sqlite roundtrip test.
